mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, level, category, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM skills WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skills (user_id, name, level, category, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{level}, #{category}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE skills SET name = #{name}, level = #{level}, category = #{category}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
